CaraShellRoof_OB_112_1.underrad: The roof is what you never see, and what costs the most to repair.
CaraShellRoof_OB_112_1.message:
A full cover protects more of your rig, but it's heavy to wrestle on by yourself and rubs against the paint all winter long.
The roof is what you never see, and what costs the most to repair.
Our cover sits there only, 21 × 10 ft, with straps on all four sides that hold it down when the wind picks up.
$199 (was $249), save $50 (20% off).
CaraShellRoof_OB_112_1.headline: The roof, not the whole rig.
